lines.speak: Welcome to Traders Journal.
lines.cap: Welcome to Traders Journal.

lines.speak: In this video you'll connect MetaTrader 5, so your trades import automatically.
lines.cap: In this video you'll connect MetaTrader 5, so your trades import automatically.

lines.speak: There are two ways to do it: Direct Local Sync, which is the recommended one, and the Expert Advisor method as a backup.
lines.cap: There are two ways to do it: Direct Local Sync, which is the recommended one, and the Expert Advisor method as a backup.

lines.speak: Everything stays on your PC, and the connection is read-only.
lines.cap: Everything stays on your PC, and the connection is read-only.

lines.speak: Method one: Direct Local Sync.
lines.cap: Method one: Direct Local Sync.

lines.speak: It takes about a minute.
lines.cap: It takes about a minute.

lines.speak: First, open MetaTrader 5 and log in to the account you want to journal.
lines.cap: First, open MetaTrader 5 and log in to the account you want to journal.

lines.speak: Demo or live both work.
lines.cap: Demo or live both work.

lines.speak: Check the bottom right corner: you should see a connection speed, not, no connection.
lines.cap: Check the bottom right corner: you should see a connection speed, not “No connection”.

lines.speak: Now switch to Traders Journal and click Connections in the sidebar.
lines.cap: Switch to Traders Journal and click Connections in the sidebar.

lines.speak: At the top is the MetaTrader 5 Direct Local Sync card.
lines.cap: At the top is the MetaTrader 5 Direct Local Sync card.

lines.speak: If MT5 isn't linked yet, the badge says Disconnected.
lines.cap: If MT5 isn't linked yet, the badge says Disconnected.

lines.speak: This method needs no code, no download, and no WebRequest setting.
lines.cap: This method needs no code, no download and no WebRequest setting.

lines.speak: Press Sync Now.
lines.cap: Press Sync Now.

lines.speak: Traders Journal reads your history straight from the terminal.
lines.cap: Traders Journal reads your history straight from the terminal.

lines.speak: Within seconds the badge turns green, your account, server and balance fill in, and the synced positions counter shows how many trades were imported.
lines.cap: Within seconds the badge turns green, your account, server and balance fill in, and the synced positions counter shows how many trades were imported.

lines.speak: The activity log tells you exactly what happened.
lines.cap: The activity log tells you exactly what happened.

lines.speak: Next, tick Live Auto-Sync.
lines.cap: Tick Live Auto-Sync.

lines.speak: From now on, new trades arrive on their own, every three seconds.
lines.cap: From now on, new trades arrive on their own, every three seconds.

lines.speak: Keep Traders Journal running in the tray, and keep MetaTrader 5 open.
lines.cap: Keep Traders Journal running in the tray, and keep MetaTrader 5 open.

lines.speak: That's it.
lines.cap: That's it.

lines.speak: Open the Dashboard to see your stats, equity curve and calendar, or Trade Logging to browse every synced trade.
lines.cap: Open the Dashboard to see your stats, equity curve and calendar, or Trade Logging to browse every synced trade.

lines.speak: Disconnect only removes the data from this app.
lines.cap: Disconnect only removes the data from this app.

lines.speak: It never touches MetaTrader.
lines.cap: It never touches MetaTrader.

lines.speak: Method two: the Expert Advisor connector.
lines.cap: Method two: the Expert Advisor connector.

lines.speak: Use it if direct sync isn't available on your machine.
lines.cap: Use it if direct sync isn't available on your machine.

lines.speak: It has seven short steps, and you only do them once.
lines.cap: It has seven short steps, and you only do them once.

lines.speak: Step one.
lines.cap: Step 1.

lines.speak: In Connections, scroll to the Expert Advisor section.
lines.cap: In Connections, scroll to the Expert Advisor section.

lines.speak: Pick MetaTrader 5, name the connection, choose how much history to import, and press Generate connection code.
lines.cap: Pick MetaTrader 5, name the connection, choose how much history to import, and press Generate connection code.

lines.speak: The code is single use, and valid for thirty minutes.
lines.cap: The code is single-use and valid for 30 minutes.

lines.speak: Step two.
lines.cap: Step 2.

lines.speak: Press Download connector.
lines.cap: Press Download connector.

lines.speak: The file is saved to your Downloads folder, with the code and the local address already written inside it.
lines.cap: The file is saved to your Downloads folder, with the code and the local address already written inside it.

lines.speak: There's nothing to type later.
lines.cap: There's nothing to type later.

lines.speak: Step three.
lines.cap: Step 3.

lines.speak: In MetaTrader, choose File, then Open Data Folder.
lines.cap: In MetaTrader, choose File → Open Data Folder.

lines.speak: Open M Q L 5, then Experts, and drop the connector file in there.
lines.cap: Open MQL5, then Experts, and drop the connector file in there.

lines.speak: Step four.
lines.cap: Step 4.

lines.speak: Press F4 to open MetaEditor.
lines.cap: Press F4 to open MetaEditor.

lines.speak: Double-click the connector in the Navigator, then press F7 to compile.
lines.cap: Double-click the connector in the Navigator, then press F7 to compile.

lines.speak: The log at the bottom should say zero errors.
lines.cap: The log at the bottom should say 0 errors.

lines.speak: Step five.
lines.cap: Step 5.

lines.speak: Back in MetaTrader, open Tools, Options, and the Expert Advisors tab.
lines.cap: Back in MetaTrader, open Tools → Options → Expert Advisors.

lines.speak: Tick Allow WebRequest for listed URL, then add exactly this address: http colon slash slash one two seven dot zero dot zero dot one, colon eight seven six five.
lines.cap: Tick “Allow WebRequest for listed URL”, then add exactly this address: http://127.0.0.1:8765.

lines.speak: Press OK.
lines.cap: Press OK.

lines.speak: Step six.
lines.cap: Step 6.

lines.speak: Open the Navigator and drag the connector onto any chart.
lines.cap: Open the Navigator and drag the connector onto any chart.

lines.speak: On the Inputs tab, the code and address are already filled in.
lines.cap: On the Inputs tab, the code and address are already filled in.

lines.speak: Leave live trading off, and press OK.
lines.cap: Leave live trading off, and press OK.

lines.speak: Step seven.
lines.cap: Step 7.

lines.speak: Open the Experts tab.
lines.cap: Open the Experts tab.

lines.speak: You should see, Traders Journal Sync: connected, and a smiley face in the corner of the chart.
lines.cap: You should see TradersJournal Sync: connected, and a smiley face in the corner of the chart.

lines.speak: Your history now flows into Traders Journal.
lines.cap: Your history now flows into Traders Journal.

lines.speak: If something goes wrong, check three things.
lines.cap: If something goes wrong, check three things.

lines.speak: MetaTrader must be open and logged in.
lines.cap: MetaTrader must be open and logged in.

lines.speak: Both apps must run at the same Windows privilege level, so don't start only one as Administrator.
lines.cap: Both apps must run at the same Windows privilege level, so don't start only one as Administrator.

lines.speak: And for error four zero one four, add the local address to the WebRequest list.
lines.cap: And for error 4014, add the local address to the WebRequest list.

lines.speak: The full troubleshooting list is in the guide.
lines.cap: The full troubleshooting list is in the guide.

lines.speak: You're all set.
lines.cap: You're all set.

lines.speak: Your trades will now sync into Traders Journal automatically.
lines.cap: Your trades will now sync into Traders Journal automatically.

lines.speak: Happy trading.
lines.cap: Happy trading.
